anomalies.observed: The netlist contains two MCU components, U2 (ATtiny45-20P) and U3 (ATtiny13V-10S), wired pin-for-pin to the same nets. For example, PWM connects to U2 pin 6 and U3 pin 6, SDA to U2 pin 5 and U3 pin 5, SCK to U2 pin 7 and U3 pin 7, and the reset, pot, tach, +5V, and GND pins are also shared.
anomalies.expected: The specification describes an ATtiny-driven fan controller, implying one ATtiny MCU. If multiple footprints were intended as alternatives, only one MCU should be populated or marked DNP; both should not be connected as active components.
anomalies.impact: If both MCUs are assembled, their output drivers are tied together on PWM, SDA, SCK, and reset, causing bus contention, unreliable fan control/I2C behavior, and possible device damage.
